user.title: Z-Wave multicast group
user.description: Group Z-Wave JS entities into one entity that commands them with a single Z-Wave multicast frame, so they act at the same moment. Pick the kind of group.

cover.title: Z-Wave multicast cover group
cover.description: Combine Z-Wave covers into one cover that moves them with a single Z-Wave multicast frame, so they start at the same moment.

data_description.entities: Z-Wave JS covers that report a position (not gates or garage doors). Non-secure members on the same controller are sent one multicast; the rest are sent the normal command.
data_description.travel_time: Seconds the slowest member needs end to end. The group shows opening/closing for this long, then checks each member really arrived and re-sends to any that didn't.

fan.title: Z-Wave multicast fan group
fan.description: Combine Z-Wave fans into one fan that turns them on, off or to a speed with a single Z-Wave multicast frame. Preset modes stay on the members.

data_description.entities: Z-Wave JS Multilevel Switch fans. Non-secure members on the same controller are sent one multicast; the rest are sent the normal command.
data_description.verify_delay: Seconds to wait before checking each member really got the command and re-sending to any that didn't. A light's transition is added on top.

light.title: Z-Wave multicast light group
light.description: Combine Z-Wave lights into one light that turns them on, off or to a brightness with a single Z-Wave multicast frame. Color stays on the members.

data_description.entities: Z-Wave JS lights switched by a Multilevel or Binary Switch. Non-secure members on the same controller are sent one multicast; the rest are sent the normal command.
data_description.verify_delay: Seconds to wait before checking each member really got the command and re-sending to any that didn't. A light's transition is added on top.

switch.title: Z-Wave multicast switch group
switch.description: Combine Z-Wave switches into one switch that turns them on or off with a single Z-Wave multicast frame.

data_description.entities: Z-Wave JS Binary Switches. Non-secure members on the same controller are sent one multicast; the rest are sent the normal command.
data_description.verify_delay: Seconds to wait before checking each member really got the command and re-sending to any that didn't. A light's transition is added on top.

error.not_position_cover: Every member must be a Z-Wave JS cover that reports a position.
error.unsupported_member: Every member must be a Z-Wave JS entity of this type that this group can multicast to (see the member list description).
error.unsafe_member: Gates and garage doors can't be grouped.
